description: NITER_Parallax is a pre-formed team for NASA Space Apps 2026, Dhaka, working on the Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge.
summary: FireChronicle is a satellite-based fire intelligence dashboard that harmonizes active fire observations from NASA's MODIS and VIIRS instruments. It addresses the challenge of comparing fire hotspot data from different satellite sensors, which often vary in spatial resolution, observation time, and data format. The platform provides an interactive fire map, advanced data filtering, timelines, sensor comparison, hotspot matching, and downloadable reports. By transforming multiple satellite observations into a unified and accessible interface, FireChronicle helps researchers, environmental analysts, and disaster-response teams explore fire activity, identify differences between sensors, and better understand wildfire patterns. The project uses NASA FIRMS data and aims to make satellite-based fire monitoring more accessible and useful.
details:
FireChronicle is an interactive fire intelligence dashboard designed to harmonize and analyze active fire observations from NASA's MODIS and VIIRS satellite instruments.

The platform allows users to upload NASA FIRMS CSV files or retrieve available fire data through the FIRMS Area API. It also provides a clearly labeled sample dataset for exploration.

Key features include:

  • Interactive Fire Map for visualizing active fire hotspots.
  • Data filtering by date, satellite, confidence, and other observation attributes.
  • Timeline and Activity Calendar for exploring fire activity over time.
  • Sensor Comparison for examining MODIS and VIIRS observations.
  • Geographic and temporal hotspot matching using distance and time-based comparisons.
  • Disagreement and Harmonization analysis to explore differences between satellite observations.
  • Data Explorer with downloadable filtered CSV reports.
  • Anomaly Insights, Fire Brief, and Data Quality tools for further exploration.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, and PapaParse. Google Gemini API provides conversational assistance when available, with a local analysis engine as a fallback when the API is unavailable.

FireChronicle combines satellite data visualization, data harmonization, and accessible analytical tools in one platform. Its goal is to help users better understand wildfire observations and support more informed environmental monitoring and research.
